commits.summary: Compare independent scalar proof consumers (verification pending)
commits.body:
Both routes start with the same compiled public multiply and add methods. Rust decodes the class and reduces JVM stack expressions modulo 2^32. Lean reads the complete file as a literal term, finds Code through the constant pool and proves a normal return with unchanged heap for every 32-bit input. Its shifted peer differs at zero. The Lean proof uses the standard propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound axioms. The Linux read-only consumer sandbox excludes the original producer, verdicts and proof caches.

The separate Rust and Lean probes accepted the original class, the named Lean negative theorem checked, and all 59 selected Rust test binaries passed. Job 20261123-192639-compare-isolated-rust-and-lean-on-compil repeats each check three times under isolation. Merge the two original producer baselines: both matched the archived status and every obligation, 10 answers for Ints and 11 for Longs.
